source.label: FSSAI Contaminants, Toxins and Residues Compendium Version IX

key_findings: Cocoa powder lead article has a dry fat-free basis. Cocoa beans, cocoa mass/liquor and cocoa/sugar mixtures are not automatically cocoa powder.
Water dispensed through a vending machine cannot automatically be treated as packaged drinking water; lead comparator is water-form-specific.
Lead rows distinguish ready-use infant formula and broader infant foods; child supplements need target-age and legal-class verification.
Nickel contaminant row names sorbitol, not an entire group of polyols; 09.006 nickel internal standard is not a nickel-result method.
Aflatoxins total and B1 have distinct articles and analytes; functional premixes need actual crop-containing BOM evidence.
Pesticide residue MRL is chemical- and commodity-specific; dried or pickled eggs need shell-free basis and processing factor before use.
